method.voiced_rule: RMS >= -40 dBFS, under-1kHz power >= 0.60, normalized periodicity >= 0.50
method.periodicity: Maximum normalized autocorrelation, 100-400 Hz; computed only for low-band power >= 0.5 and RMS >= -48dBFS
method.important_limit: Heuristic screening only. Stop releases, creaky voice and recording conditions can cause false results. Absence of this pattern is not pronunciation approval. Review phoneme ASR and listen separately.

classification_source.method: en-US eSpeak labels computed after independent phoneme recognition

classification.spoken_text: Hello, number explorers! Let's count in binary.
Binary uses only two digits: zero and one.
We read each digit from left to right.
This says one zero. Its value is two.
The small number shows the value.
Bright means one. Dark means zero.
Our example is finished. Now let's start at zero.

results.spoken_text: We read each digit from left to right.
